diagnostics.message: `get_node_or_null("FieldScreen")` does not resolve. res://ui/playable_shell.tscn attaches this script to the scene root `PlayableShell`, and there is no node `FieldScreen` at that point in the tree.
diagnostics.suggested_fix: In res://ui/playable_shell.tscn the script is on the scene root `PlayableShell`, and the path `FieldScreen` breaks at `FieldScreen`. PlayableShell has no children in the scene file. Point the path at one of those children, or add a node named `FieldScreen` there with add_node. A path in a script is relative to the node the script is attached to, not to the scene root — use `%UniqueName` or an `@export var target: NodePath` when the node lives elsewhere.
